question.prompt: Which chart-context change should clear a locked allocation selection?

options.label: Any chart switch
options.detail: Treat a switch to another chart view within the dashboard as the clearing trigger.

options.label: Time-range only
options.detail: Do not author a separate chart-context trigger unless another source names the control.

options.label: Provide source
options.detail: Add a source that defines the chart-context control and its clearing behavior.

content.risk_rationale: The reset trigger changes cross-view behavior and scenario coverage; without a defined chart-context control, any chart-switch scenario would otherwise rest on a guess.
